format.scenario: `id`; `from`, the reference test it mirrors (src/main/page/<file>:<line>) or the design; `step`, the APR-5 PR that replays it; `world`, the documents (the requester first), each window's selected chain (null: none, so Gnosis), the Identity & Wallet switch (`enabled`), the vault's lock, Agent custody at the first read, the active account, and `wallets` where the scenario changes the top-level list; `grants`, dapp-permissions.json before the first request and after the last, as the reference store wrote it; then `requests`, run in order on the same world.
format.request: `method`, `params` (absent: none given), `effects` in order, `result` (the dispatcher's), `keyless` (what a name-revalidated method registered to answer once the name no longer holds), `answer` (what main delivers: `{ gone: true }` when the document has gone), and `after`, the events main sends once it has answered.
format.effect: `effect`, `args`, and `answer` (absent for none) or `throws` (`code`, `message`, `data`). `chain.request`: a read through the core, with `origin` the routing hint (absent for transaction-service.js's estimate); `chain.fee_quote`; `name.check`: a DNS name over IPNS resolved again, true while it answers the document's IPNS key (false ends the binding); `prompt`: `{ kind, view }`, with `refused`, the picks the prompt refused while it stayed open, and the decision (`{ approve, choices }`, `{ closed }`, or `{ error }` for a busy window); `token.issue` and `token.spend` (tokens named in the order minted); `custody`; `core.typed_data_view` (the core's view, scripted as approvals.json's rules script it; the hash is EIP-712's); `sign.message` and `sign.typed_data` (the signature of the account's test key, or the device's failure); `fees.check` and `fees.at_approval` (scripted verdicts); `send.paused`, `send.turn`, `send.waiting` (D12); `send.sign` (the prepared transaction, without a nonce), `send.broadcast` (its hash); `grant.write`; `chain.select`; `agent.request`; `event` (`to` a document's id); and `world`, a change the scenario makes while a prompt is open (`navigated`, `grant-revoked`, `signing-rule-off`, `wallet-removed:<index>`, `vault-unlocked`, `custody-entered`).
